_howTo: List the games you've worked on by place ID: the number in roblox.com/games/<placeId>/name. Name, icon, thumbnail, studio, visits, playing-now, favorites and likes are pulled from Roblox automatically every 6 hours. Fill in peakCCU (Creator Hub > Analytics) and role yourself, because Roblox doesn't publish them. Set robloxUserId to show your real avatar.
